posts.title: Talking with your teenager about acne
posts.excerpt: Acne is common and treatable; the first visit is mostly a conversation.
posts.content:
Acne can affect confidence long before it affects the skin much. At the first visit we listen to the teenager first, look at the skin and agree one simple routine.

We review it after a few weeks, because most acne plans need time before anything changes.

posts.title: Choosing and using sunscreen
posts.excerpt: A plain guide to the amount, the timing and the shade and hat that go with it.
posts.content:
The best sunscreen is the one you will actually wear. Apply it generously to dry skin before going outside, and again after swimming or long hours outdoors.

Shade, a hat and sensible timing do as much as any cream.

posts.title: What a cosmetic consultation involves
posts.excerpt: The consultation comes first, is credited to treatment, and starts with your questions.
posts.content:
A cosmetic consultation is a conversation. Dr. Raman asks what bothers you, examines the skin and explains what treatments can and cannot do.

The $60 consultation fee is credited toward any treatment you choose.
